blocks.title: Read Me First
rows: Filled by trainers as the trainee completes each module. Three streams.
This tracks a Front Desk Manager's training across 7 modules in 3 streams.
Operations Audit (M1-M3): Reception, Housekeeping, Therapist Cabin (operational).
Client Experience (M4): Complaint handling & service recovery.
Reporting & Leadership (M5-M7): Ops Metrics, Floor Discipline, Escalation.
Each module sheet has competencies. Trainers score 0 (not yet) or 1 (signed off). Sign-off requires evidence, not attendance.
Final Test (last sheet): three consecutive solo days running the operations & audit cycle at Chandigarh.
Deployment happens only when all 7 modules signed off + Final Test passed.

blocks.title: M1 Reception
rows: Can audit reception team against 10-item scorecard
Independent audit vs Jaspreet, within 1 point
Can run reception morning huddle independently (5 min)
Can coach a receptionist on a specific gap in under 10 min
Can identify CRM hygiene issues — entries, tags, callbacks

blocks.title: M2 Housekeeping
rows: Can audit housekeeping against 6-item wall-poster standard
Independent audit vs Arshpreet, within 1 point
Can run housekeeping huddle in Hindi (right register)
Can coach housekeeping without triggering fear or withdrawal
Understands compliance framework & branch audit linkage

blocks.title: M3 Cabin Audit
rows: Can audit cabin operational standard — prep, hygiene, timer, handoff, log
Can identify rushed sessions / skipped operational steps
Knows the three operational rules — timer, handoff, log
Knows operational vs clinical boundary (clinical = doctor)

blocks.title: M4 Client Experience
rows: Can hold greeting & wait-time standards on the floor
Can close a DSAT the same day within SLA
Can read NPS / CSAT and complaint trends

blocks.title: M5 Ops Metrics
rows: Can compile & file the morning readiness report
Can compile & file the end-of-day operations report
Can build the weekly operations report

blocks.title: M6 Floor Discipline
rows: Can run the daily floor — huddles, hourly rounds, asks register
Can verify CCTV & secure cash with reception at closing
Can feed operational inputs into the BM-Doctor meeting

blocks.title: M7 Escalation
rows: Knows the escalation matrix — L1 floor, L2 Saurabh, L3 immediate
Understands hard-line discipline & the operations line

blocks.title: Final Test
rows: After all 7 modules signed off. Trainee runs the operations & audit cycle solo for 3 consecutive days; Jaspreet observes.
Deployment is approved only when all 3 days run cleanly and every area passes.

blocks.title: Master Sign-Off
rows: All modules must show SIGNED OFF and the Final Test must be passed before deployment.
